thecatalog.desc.minecraft.prismarine: A teal stone that slowly shifts color, found in ocean monuments. Craft four prismarine shards into one. It has stairs, slabs and walls.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.prismarine_bri: Neat teal bricks from ocean monuments. Craft nine prismarine shards into one block. They have stairs and slabs.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.dark_prismarin: A dark teal stone from ocean monuments. Craft eight prismarine shards around black dye. It has stairs and slabs.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.prismarine_sta: Stairs made of prismarine. Craft six prismarine in a stair shape, or use a stonecutter. Their color slowly shifts like the original block.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.prismarine_bri: Stairs made of prismarine bricks. Craft six bricks in a stair shape, or use a stonecutter. They suit ocean-themed builds.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.dark_prismarin: Stairs made of dark prismarine. Craft six blocks in a stair shape, or use a stonecutter. They suit deep ocean builds.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.sea_lantern: A glowing block found in ocean monuments and ruins. It gives off full light, even under water. Craft it from prismarine shards and crystals; without Silk Touch it drops crystals.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.red_sandstone: Sandstone made from red sand, found under badlands. Craft four red sand into one. It can be cut, chiseled or smoothed.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.chiseled_red_s: Red sandstone carved with a wither-like pattern. Craft two red sandstone slabs stacked, or use a stonecutter. It suits badlands builds.

thecatalog.desc.minecraft.piston: A block that pushes up to twelve blocks when powered. It can't push obsidian, bedrock or blocks with containers. Add a slimeball to make a sticky piston.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.sticky_piston: A piston with a slimeball on its face. It pushes blocks when powered and pulls them back when unpowered. It is the heart of most hidden doors.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.slime_block: A bouncy green block made from nine slimeballs. You bounce off it instead of taking fall damage. Moved by a piston, it drags neighbouring blocks along.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.honey_block: A sticky block made from four honey bottles. It slows you down, stops you jumping and lets you slide slowly down its sides. Pistons can use it to move blocks, but it won't stick to slime.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.observer: A redstone component that watches the block in front of it. When that block changes, it sends a short pulse out of its back. It powers many crop farms.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.hopper: A funnel made from five iron ingots and a chest. It pulls items from above and pushes them into the container it points at. A redstone signal locks it.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.dispenser: A block that uses or fires items when powered. It shoots arrows and fire charges, places water and lava, and equips armor on players in front of it. Craft it from cobblestone, a bow and redstone.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.dropper: A block that drops an item out of its face when powered. Pointed into a container, it moves items instead. Craft it from seven cobblestone and redstone.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.lectern: A reading stand that holds a book and quill or a written book, so several players can read it. It is the job site of librarians. A comparator reads which page is open.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.target: A block that sends a redstone signal when hit by a projectile; the closer to the centre, the stronger. Craft it from a hay bale and four redstone dust. It is great for archery games and switches.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.lever: A switch that stays on or off when flipped. Craft it from a stick and cobblestone. It is the simplest way to power redstone.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.lightning_rod: A copper rod that attracts lightning strikes nearby, protecting flammable builds. It gives off a redstone signal when struck. Craft it from three copper ingots.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.daylight_detec: A sensor that outputs redstone power based on sunlight. Right-click it to invert it into a night detector. Craft it from glass, nether quartz and wooden slabs.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.sculk_sensor: A sculk block that detects vibrations like footsteps and doors within eight blocks and gives off a redstone signal. Wool blocks and sneaking keep you hidden from it. It is found in the deep dark.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.calibrated_scu: A sculk sensor tuned with amethyst shards. A redstone signal on its side makes it listen only for one kind of vibration. It also hears a little further than a normal sensor.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.tripwire_hook: A hook that, with string stretched between two of them, makes a tripwire. Walking through the string sends a redstone signal. Craft it from an iron ingot, a stick and planks.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.trapped_chest: A chest that gives off a redstone signal when opened. The more players look inside, the stronger the signal. Craft it from a chest and a tripwire hook.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.tnt: An explosive block made from five gunpowder and four sand. Light it with flint and steel, fire or redstone, then stand back. It destroys most blocks around it.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.redstone_lamp: A lamp that lights up only while powered by redstone. Craft it from four redstone dust around glowstone. It gives full light when on.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.note_block: A block that plays a note when hit or powered. Right-click to change the pitch; the block underneath changes the instrument. Craft it from eight planks and redstone.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.stone_button: A stone button that sends a short redstone pulse when pressed. Craft it from one stone. Unlike wooden buttons, arrows can't press it.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.polished_black: A blackstone button that sends a short redstone pulse when pressed. Craft it from one polished blackstone. Arrows can't press it.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.oak_button: A wooden button that sends a short redstone pulse when pressed. Craft it from one oak plank. Arrows can press wooden buttons too.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.spruce_button: A wooden button that sends a short redstone pulse when pressed. Craft it from one spruce plank. Arrows can press wooden buttons too.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.birch_button: A wooden button that sends a short redstone pulse when pressed. Craft it from one birch plank. Arrows can press wooden buttons too.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.jungle_button: A wooden button that sends a short redstone pulse when pressed. Craft it from one jungle plank. Arrows can press wooden buttons too.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.acacia_button: A wooden button that sends a short redstone pulse when pressed. Craft it from one acacia plank. Arrows can press wooden buttons too.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.cherry_button: A wooden button that sends a short redstone pulse when pressed. Craft it from one cherry plank. Arrows can press wooden buttons too.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.dark_oak_butto: A wooden button that sends a short redstone pulse when pressed. Craft it from one dark oak plank. Arrows can press wooden buttons too.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.mangrove_butto: A wooden button that sends a short redstone pulse when pressed. Craft it from one mangrove plank. Arrows can press wooden buttons too.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.bamboo_button: A wooden button that sends a short redstone pulse when pressed. Craft it from one bamboo plank. Arrows can press wooden buttons too.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.crimson_button: A wooden button that sends a short redstone pulse when pressed. Craft it from one crimson plank. Arrows can press wooden buttons too. Like all Nether wood, it never burns.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.warped_button: A wooden button that sends a short redstone pulse when pressed. Craft it from one warped plank. Arrows can press wooden buttons too. Like all Nether wood, it never burns.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.stone_pressure: A stone plate that powers redstone when a mob or player stands on it. Craft it from two stone. Dropped items don't trigger it.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.polished_black: A blackstone plate that powers redstone when a mob or player stands on it. Craft it from two polished blackstone. Dropped items don't trigger it.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.light_weighted: A gold pressure plate that gives a stronger signal the more things stand on it. Craft it from two gold ingots. It counts items as well as mobs.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.heavy_weighted: An iron pressure plate that measures weight, needing many more things for a strong signal. Craft it from two iron ingots. It counts items as well as mobs.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.oak_pressure_p: A wooden plate that powers redstone when something presses it. Craft it from two oak planks. Unlike stone plates, it also reacts to dropped items and arrows.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.spruce_pressur: A wooden plate that powers redstone when something presses it. Craft it from two spruce planks. Unlike stone plates, it also reacts to dropped items and arrows.

thecatalog.desc.minecraft.iron_door: A sturdy door that only redstone can open, such as a button or lever. Craft six iron ingots into three doors. Zombies can't break it.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.oak_door: A wooden door that opens by hand or with redstone. Craft six oak planks into three doors. Villagers open wooden doors, and zombies can break them on Hard difficulty.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.spruce_door: A wooden door that opens by hand or with redstone. Craft six spruce planks into three doors. Villagers open wooden doors, and zombies can break them on Hard difficulty.

thecatalog.desc.minecraft.warped_door: A wooden door that opens by hand or with redstone. Craft six warped planks into three doors. Villagers open wooden doors, and zombies can break them on Hard difficulty. Like all Nether wood, it never burns.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.copper_door: A copper door made from six copper ingots. It opens by hand or with redstone. It oxidizes over time; wax it with honeycomb to keep its shine.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.exposed_copper: A copper door made from six copper ingots. It opens by hand or with redstone. It has started to oxidize and will keep aging unless waxed.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.weathered_copp: A copper door made from six copper ingots. It opens by hand or with redstone. It is mostly oxidized; wax it to keep this look or scrape it with an axe.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.oxidized_coppe: A copper door made from six copper ingots. It opens by hand or with redstone. It is fully oxidized; an axe scrapes the patina off.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.waxed_copper_d: A copper door made from six copper ingots. It opens by hand or with redstone. It is sealed with wax, so it never oxidizes.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.waxed_exposed_: A copper door made from six copper ingots. It opens by hand or with redstone. It is sealed with wax at the first stage of oxidation.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.waxed_weathere: A copper door made from six copper ingots. It opens by hand or with redstone. It is sealed with wax in its mostly green stage.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.waxed_oxidized: A copper door made from six copper ingots. It opens by hand or with redstone. It is sealed with wax in its fully teal stage.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.iron_trapdoor: An iron hatch that only redstone can open. Craft it from four iron ingots. It makes secure floor and wall hatches.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.oak_trapdoor: A wooden hatch that opens by hand or with redstone. Craft six oak planks into two trapdoors. Place it on the top or bottom half of a block, or above a ladder as a hatch.

thecatalog.desc.minecraft.oak_fence_gate: A gate for oak fences that opens by hand or with redstone. Craft it from two oak planks and four sticks. Mobs can't open it.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.spruce_fence_g: A gate for spruce fences that opens by hand or with redstone. Craft it from two spruce planks and four sticks. Mobs can't open it.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.birch_fence_ga: A gate for birch fences that opens by hand or with redstone. Craft it from two birch planks and four sticks. Mobs can't open it.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.jungle_fence_g: A gate for jungle fences that opens by hand or with redstone. Craft it from two jungle planks and four sticks. Mobs can't open it.

thecatalog.desc.minecraft.powered_rail: A rail that speeds minecarts up when powered and brakes them when not. Craft gold ingots, a stick and redstone into six. Place one every so often to keep carts moving.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.detector_rail: A rail that gives off a redstone signal while a minecart is on it. Craft it from iron ingots, a stone pressure plate and redstone. Use it to trigger stations and switches.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.rail: The basic track for minecarts. Craft six iron ingots and a stick into sixteen. Rails curve automatically to connect to each other.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.activator_rail: A rail that triggers special minecarts when powered. It ignites TNT minecarts, toggles hopper minecarts and throws riders off. Craft it from iron, sticks and a redstone torch.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.saddle: Gear for riding horses, donkeys, mules, pigs and striders. It can't be crafted; find it in chests, while fishing or from leatherworkers. Pigs and striders also need a lure on a stick to steer.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.minecart: A cart that rides along rails. Craft it from five iron ingots. Players and mobs can ride in it, and it can be combined with a chest, furnace, hopper or TNT.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.chest_minecart: A minecart carrying a chest with 27 slots. Craft it from a minecart and a chest. Hoppers can load and unload it, making it perfect for item transport.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.furnace_mineca: A minecart with a furnace that pushes itself and other carts. Give it coal or charcoal to start it moving. It is the only self-powered minecart.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.tnt_minecart: A minecart loaded with TNT. It explodes when it passes over a powered activator rail or crashes from a height. Craft it from a minecart and TNT.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.hopper_minecar: A minecart with a hopper that collects items along the track and from containers above. Craft it from a minecart and a hopper. Pair it with a hopper below the rails to unload it.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.carrot_on_a_st: A fishing rod with a carrot tied to it. Hold it while riding a saddled pig to steer it. Each boost wears it down a little.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.warped_fungus_: A fishing rod with a warped fungus tied to it. Hold it while riding a saddled strider to steer it across lava. Each boost wears it down a little.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.elytra: Wings found on End ships, worn in the chestplate slot. Jump while falling to glide, and use firework rockets to fly. Repair it with phantom membranes.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.oak_boat: A oak boat for crossing water quickly. Craft it from five oak planks. It carries two passengers, and mobs pushed into it get stuck.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.oak_chest_boat: A oak boat with a chest on board. Craft it from a oak boat and a chest. It carries one passenger plus 27 slots of cargo.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.spruce_boat: A spruce boat for crossing water quickly. Craft it from five spruce planks. It carries two passengers, and mobs pushed into it get stuck.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.spruce_chest_b: A spruce boat with a chest on board. Craft it from a spruce boat and a chest. It carries one passenger plus 27 slots of cargo.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.birch_boat: A birch boat for crossing water quickly. Craft it from five birch planks. It carries two passengers, and mobs pushed into it get stuck.
thecatalog.desc.minecraft.birch_chest_bo: A birch boat with a chest on board. Craft it from a birch boat and a chest. It carries one passenger plus 27 slots of cargo.
